devices.label: IDE-40
devices.part: 40 Pin flat cable connector for IDE HDD HDD is 3.5" Quantum Fireball CR 4.3AT Game is married to the factory-supplied HDD brand+model and swapping in a different (replacement) HDD will result in an error at boot-up. The HDD check is done by the H8/3644 MCU. If the HDD needs to be replaced use an identical brand/model. If and/or when the MCU is decapped the check can be modified or removed.
